notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Community Daze Celebration in Carbon County/East Carbon, 435-888-6613. She called Grant on May 12, 2026; note says to check on things regarding the celebration. Adventure Zone has prior Gmail outreach to East Carbon Community Daze.
